summary: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 14, 2026, announcing the grant of 68,000 stock options to officers, employees, and consultants under its Long-Term Incentive Plan. Options are exercisable at $1.87, vest in three equal annual installments beginning April 1, 2027, and have a five-year term. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. The filing reflects standard management incentive alignment, with no transaction, strategic review, or capital structure event.
